Signal.description: A typed Luau signal created with signal with (...). Engine and public script signals use the same type. Luau uses fire; GDScript sees a native Godot Signal and uses emit.

members.fire: Calls connected handlers with the signal arguments. Engine-backed signals also notify GDScript handlers.
members.connect: Connects a handler and returns a Luau Connection. Handler parameter types come from the signal.
members.once: Connects a handler for the next emission only and returns a Connection.
members.wait: Suspends the current resumable thread until the signal fires, then returns its arguments.
members.disconnect_all: Disconnects handlers made through the Luau API. Editor and GDScript connections stay connected.
